data.narrative:
Aepnus Technology is a Seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Lukas Hackl and Bilen Akuzum that has raised $10.6M to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector comprises one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix. However, the peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables to support a robust median-based valuation; the company operates in a sparse subsegment where narrow peer filtering yields fewer than three datapoints.

Given data constraints, stage-progression methodology is the primary applicable triangulation approach. Using the $10.6M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to next stage yields an implied valuation of $26.5M. This reflects standard market progression dynamics for early-stage climate technology, absent transaction multiples from narrow-set peers.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $23M (low) to $30M (high), centered on $26M median. This range is constrained by reliance on a single method; key uncertainties include (1) the applicability of standard stage-progression multiples to frontier energy and materials subsectors, which may exhibit different risk/return profiles, and (2) the absence of recent comparable transactions at similar stage and capitalization. Narrower precision would require either closer sectoral peers or disclosed transaction data from the identified comparable set.
